summary: Code in a raised card with a file name or tabs, a copy button and marked lines; your highlighter fills the lines.

props.name: code
props.description: The text to show, and what Copy puts on the clipboard.

props.name: lines
props.description: The same text from your highlighter, one node per line. Without it the lines show plain.

props.name: title
props.description: A file name in the header, beside a file icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph before `title`, in place of the file icon.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Versions of the same snippet, one per tab, such as package managers.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: How many lines show before the block scrolls. Shift and the wheel scroll it sideways.

props.name: fill
props.description: Takes its container's height and scrolls inside it, in place of `maxLines`.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: What the copy button says for a moment once it has copied.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the block and its buttons. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: animated
props.description: The scrollbars fading in while you scroll or hover. Turn it off to keep them shown; reduced motion does the same.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.title: save.tsx
